newsitem.title: DUBAI: Qatar welcomes Israeli-Palestinian Hebron deal.
newsitem.headline: Qatar welcomes Israeli-Palestinian Hebron deal.

text.p: The Gulf Arab state of Qatar on Wednesday welcomed an accord between Palestinian and Israeli leaders to extend Arab rule to the West Bank town of Hebron.
the official Qatar News Agency said the cabinet considered the move an "important step" for the Middle East peace process.
Negotiators initialled the accord on the border between Israel and the Gaza Strip at a late-night summit between Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and Palestinian President Yasser Arafat.
Qatar and Oman have raced ahead of other Gulf Arab states in establishing economic ties with Israel but stopped short of diplomatic relations pending the resolution of all Arab-israeli conflicts.
